name: account-create-concurrent-name

graded_by.test: owed: Pause two creates of the same previously unused name before check-and-set. Resume both; one creates, second gets 409 user_exists. Check-and-set and audit-before-commit occur in one bbolt write transaction; exactly one account and create audit event result.
